premises.text: Hormonal health is central to women's health and affects a significant portion of women.
premises.evidence_span: Hormonal health sits at the center of women's health as every single woman is affected by our hormones and 80% of us that's 3.1 billion women suffer from a hormone related issue

premises.text: Current data on cyclical hormone levels unrelated to fertility is insufficient.
premises.evidence_span: today's data on cyclical hormone levels Unrelated to fertility and pregnancy isn't just thin on the ground it barely exists

premises.text: Women need to test their hormones on specific days to understand their levels.
premises.evidence_span: the problem with our hormones is that they change and they fluctuate constantly throughout the month They need to be tested on specific days in order to be understood

premises.text: Existing hormone testing methods are inconvenient and costly.
premises.evidence_span: Today's solution of drawing blood and waiting days for your test results is not a convenient or cost-efficient solution as you need multiple blood tests per cycle

premises.text: Hormona has developed a non-invasive urine test that provides quick results.
premises.evidence_span: our patent-pending non-invasive urine test have completely removed the need for a lab Without sacrificing quality we have decreased the time it takes for you to get your test results from five days to 15 minutes

premises.text: Regular testing can help women manage their hormonal health effectively.
premises.evidence_span: By testing regularly hormona can with time help to confirm if you're going into menopause Will have problems getting pregnant or pick up any hormonal changes that may impact your life

premises.text: The women's health market is substantial but underserved.
premises.evidence_span: The global women's health market is substantial But it's desperately underserved despite being part of everyday life for over 50% of the world's population

premises.text: Hormona aims to narrow the gender data gap in health research.
premises.evidence_span: We have the unique opportunity to contribute to narrowing that gender data gap And improve health outcomes for women all over the planet

value.text: Women gain better understanding and management of their hormonal health.
value.evidence_span: Feeling hormonal should be the start of a conversation not the end
